Nepal PM Demands Climate Action After Himalayan Disaster

Nepal's Prime Minister has called for urgent global climate action following a devastating disaster in the Himalayas. The country is acutely aware of the dangers posed by climate change, particularly in its mountainous regions. The specific nature of the disaster and the Prime Minister's demands were highlighted in the coverage.
